assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site and three key-area polygons are repository provisional constraints, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive geometry, areas and alignments must be recalculated after trusted official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Twelve service nodes, four civic links and three civic halls express relationships and program roles only.
assumptions.impact: Exact sites, owners, operators, capacity, cost, accessibility and safety require professional and public confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Every AI service retains a non-AI route, named human responsibility, data-minimisation review and stop condition.
assumptions.impact: A scenario that cannot meet these conditions must not proceed to public testing.
